name: anim_sw_form
subject: a huge muscular Doberman monster made of glossy pink paint goo with yellow marble streaks, seen from behind, growing out of a thick vertical goo stalk
desc: Seen from behind: the goo stalk bulges and swells upward, stretching stickily, and squelches out a huge broad back, shoulders and head, then the thick arms peel out and spread wide forward to embrace a wide pillar in front of it. Slow and sticky at first, then reaching.
